Not sure it's the same issue, but two things we hit that look similar from the outside.

Stuck in QUEUED: Kaggle runs at most 2 GPU batch sessions per account at once, so if two of your commits are already running, the next one just waits.

ERROR within ~2 min with a completely empty log (no traceback, no failure message): for us that was GPU quota. If you push with the CLI and no time cap, Kaggle reserves the full 12 h session, so with less than 12 h of weekly quota left it refuses to start. Fix: kaggle kernels push -p <dir> --timeout <seconds> with a value below your remaining quota (kaggle quota shows it, CLI 2.2.4+). That took us from three refusals in a row to a clean run.

P.S. If you push from Windows and get a 'charmap' codec can't decode error, set PYTHONUTF8=1 first.
